meta.description: Catalog of released Taylor Swift songs: album, year, and a few short signature phrases per song. Full lyrics are intentionally not stored.
meta.source: Wikipedia 'List of songs by Taylor Swift' (fetched 2026-11-26); phrases are short hooks only
meta.counting_rule: album_edition_first = earliest album edition containing the song (deluxe editions included; Taylor's Version re-recordings not counted again). counts_toward_album_total excludes non-album songs and the 10-minute All Too Well.
meta.excluded: covers of other writers' songs, and songs Swift wrote that only other artists released
phrases_pending: Chloe or Sam or Sophia or Marcus
meta.phrases_note: Songs in phrases_pending have no phrase yet (mostly 2025-2026 releases and obscure non-album tracks); add short hooks as they are verified.
